title: Black holes can split in two — but only if they spin at extreme speeds
caption:
Think black holes only merge? New research shows they could theoretically divide, provided they are spinning fast enough to bypass the laws of thermodynamics. Scientists are now looking for gamma-ray signals to see if this actually happens in space.

Source: Space - Black holes can split in two — but only if they spin at extreme speeds
